retirement_age.notes: Superannuation age for federal and provincial civil servants. Voluntary retirement is possible earlier (for example from 55 with 25 years of service in Punjab and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa rules). A Khyber Pakhtunkhwa amendment to raise the age to 63 was struck down by the Peshawar High Court in 2020. No statutory retirement age for elected or senior political office was found.
